main_text.p: poenituit ; adeo multa in hoc extant,quae: illum tunc in rebus Ecclesiasticis Infan-tem manifestò produnt. Ut enim dicen-di illius genus præterea,quod nimis lu-xurians Juvenem sapit, abundatq; phra-sibus ac similitudinibus longius petitis, primorum Pontificum Epistolas, quae haud dubie suppositae sunt, tanquam ge-nuinas interdum laudat; Dionysioque A-reopagitae tribuit Libros de Hierarchia ; & quod his omnibus deterius videtur, Morinus magis accedit sententiæ Romanensium aulicorum de suprema Episcopi Romani potestate,quam saniori Theolo-gorum Catholicorum, imprimisque Gal-lorum doctrinis, qui illud argumentum erudite pertractârunt. Urbanum Pon-tificem Maximum superbis hisce titulis statim à limine ornat {d} Divinitus constitueris Thesauri Ecclesiæ Custos & Præ-ses, æternitatis dispensator, mentis divinæ Interpres, legum Christianarum arbiter, omnium Mortalium Judex, unicus tui dominus & vindex. Deinde in contextu ope
{d} In Epist. Dedic. ad Urb. VII.

page.notes: The reference mark (d) in the text is printed as "(d)" and is given here as {d}. "erudite" and "pertractârunt" are read with a doubtful accent, marked here only in the transcription of the word itself. Catchword "ope" is cut off by the gutter edge in the scan. The left margin carries no printed note, only specks and a stray mark that are not text.
